Treatment for dark circles under the eyes varies depending on the type.

The dark circles under the eyes areblack/blue/brownIt is classified into three types, each with a different cause, so the selection of treatment will also differ.

In some cases, the desired change may not be achieved, and it is important to confirm the cause in order to avoid unnecessary treatments.

Three types of dark circles and how to choose the appropriate treatment
  • Black bears: Degreasing/Hamra method is effective due to protruding orbital fat
  • Blue bears: Check for transparent veins due to poor blood circulation during a medical examination
  • Brown dark circles: Laser and peeling mainly due to melanin pigment deposition

I'll explain how to tell the type later, but you can generally tell by looking at whether the skin becomes thinner when you pull it, and whether the color changes when you warm it up.

Before you receive counseling at a clinic in Nagoya, it is best to have some idea of the type of dark circles you have, so that your consultation with the doctor will go smoothly.

Below, we will explain the causes and appropriate treatments for each of the three types.

Even if it looks like a black bear, bluishness and hyperpigmentation may be present at the same time, so it is best to avoid deciding on a treatment based on color alone.

If you consult a doctor to find out the skin condition and the cause of the shadow, it will be easier to avoid unnecessary treatments and formulate a treatment plan.

Since it is not possible to determine the cause by self-examination, please also check the condition of the pigment and unevenness at a medical examination.

Black bears are caused by sagging skin and protruding fat, so the degreasing/Hamra method is effective.

Black bears under the eyesorbital fat(gankashibo) protrudes forward and its shadow appears black.

How to self-check for black bears

Gently pull the skin under your eyes to the side, and if the color or shadow of the dark circles becomes lighter, it may be a dark circle.

If a fat bulge is involved, the appearance of the shadow may change depending on the brightness and the angle of the eye.

Checking at home is not a substitute for a medical examination, so it is a good idea to tell your doctor where and when you are concerned about the shadow.

If the dark circles become lighter when you pull them, you may suspect a black bear, but you will need to see a doctor to diagnose the cause.

Main treatments and characteristics of black bear
  • Transconjunctival degreasing method: Removes fat from the back of the lower eyelid. There will be no incision marks on the skin surface, and swelling and internal bleeding should last for 1 to 2 weeks.
  • Hamra method: Repositions fat and improves sagging skin at the same time. Suitable for people with strong sagging skin
  • Removing too much fat can cause dents, so it is important to leave the decision on how much to remove to your doctor.

Transconjunctival degreasing does not cut the skin, so it leaves fewer scars and reduces downtime.About 1 to 2 weeksis the standard.

With the Hamra method, which involves making an incision on the skin side, removal of excess skin can also be considered.Suitable for people with strong sagging skin。

If too much fat is removed, there is a risk of the area under the eyes becoming sunken, so leave the decision on how much to remove to your doctor.

If you want to improve your dark circles, choose a clinic that uses degreasing or the Hamra method.

Blue bears are related to thin skin and transparent blood vessels, so a medical examination is required to select treatment.

Blue circles occur in areas where the skin under the eyes is thin.venous bloodis clearly visible.

The color of veins may be more noticeable depending on blood flow conditions and skin thickness, and their appearance may change due to factors such as lack of sleep.

An effective way to self-check is to warm the area under your eyes or press lightly with your finger.

Changes when warmed or lightly touched can be helpful, but the cause of blue circles cannot be determined just by looking at the change in color.

Blue bear treatment options
  • laser irradiation: Applicability is determined depending on the equipment used and the condition of the skin and blood vessels.
  • Hyaluronic acid injection: Replenishes skin thickness and makes veins less noticeable. short downtime
  • Combining the two may improve the improvement effect more than treatment alone.

The reason for the appearance of blue circles varies depending on the thinness of the skin and the dents, so whether laser treatment or injection treatment is more suitable will be determined through a medical examination.

Whether the laser is suitable for you depends on the condition of your blood vessels and the device, so a doctor's consultation is required.

Hyaluronic acid is mainly used to correct the hollow area under the eyes, and individual confirmation is required to see if it is effective against the blue color that makes blood vessels visible.

Combining lasers and injections is not always appropriate, so listen to the changes you can expect and side effects before choosing one.

Dark circles are caused by melanin pigmentation and are mainly treated with lasers and peels.

Dark circles appear on the skin under the eyes.melanin pigmentThis is a condition where the skin accumulates and appears brown.

Pigment builds up due to repeated UV damage and friction to the eyes (rubbing the eyes too much due to hay fever, leaving eye make-up unremoved).

A self-check is to pull the skin under your eyes.

If a brownish tinge remains even when the skin is pulled, pigmentation is suspected, but a medical examination is necessary as multiple causes may overlap.

Self-check and treatment for brown bears
  • self check: If the color does not fade even if you pull the skin and a brownish tinge remains, there is a high possibility that you have dark circles.
  • laser irradiation: Decomposes and excretes pigments using wavelengths that react with melanin pigments
  • chemical peeling: Removes melanin along with dead skin cells. Effects increase with multiple treatments
  • Recurrence is likely if you do not continue to take measures against UV rays after treatment.

The laser emits a wavelength that reacts with melanin pigment, causing it to break down and be excreted.

Peeling is a treatment that uses chemicals to affect the stratum corneum, but care must be taken to avoid irritation to the skin around the eyes and worsening of pigmentation.

Brown circles may become noticeable again if exposure to UV rays or friction continues, so please continue to use sunscreen as an aftercare after your treatment.

Of the three types of dark circles, this type is particularly susceptible to external care, so you should also review your lifestyle after the treatment.

Main treatment methods for bear removal available in Nagoya

The bear removal treatments offered at our clinic in Nagoya are“Surgical system” and “Injection system”It is divided into two types.

4 bear removal treatments available in Nagoya
  • Transconjunctival degreasing: A surgery that removes fat from the back of the lower eyelid without cutting the skin surface.
  • Urahamra method: Aims to improve bulges and dents by repositioning fat
  • Hamra method: A surgical procedure that involves skin incision and can treat severe sagging skin.
  • Hyaluronic acid injection: Injection treatment that can correct dents on the same day without surgery

The surgical systemTransconjunctival degreasing・Urahamra method・Hamra methodThere are three typical types, and the aim is to achieve fundamental improvements through fat removal and relocation.

The injection system is a method in which hyaluronic acid is filled into the dent, and is characterized by short downtime and results that can be seen on the same day.

Which treatment is suitable forType of bear and severity of symptomsIt depends.

If the main cause of dark circles is fat bulges, degreasing is an option, if the dents are deep and sagging, then the Ura Hamura method or Hamura method is an option, and if the dents are mild, hyaluronic acid injection is an option.

Below, we will explain the mechanism and characteristics of each treatment in order.

However, if the main cause is bluish or brown pigmentation, the color problem may remain even after fat surgery.

Don't just choose a treatment based on its name, check to see which symptoms your doctor says it will treat.

Transconjunctival degreasing is a surgery that removes fat from the back of the lower eyelid without cutting into the skin surface.

Transconjunctival degreasing involves making a small incision from the inside of the lower eyelid (conjunctival side).orbital fatThis is a treatment to remove.

Because no scars are left on the skin surface, this surgery has little effect on appearance after surgery, and is often chosen by people who are in a hurry to return to work.

Swelling and internal bleeding may last from a few days to 1 to 2 weeks, and the time it takes to become less noticeable varies from person to person.

Overview of transconjunctival degreasing
  • approach: An incision is made from the inside of the lower eyelid (conjunctival side). Less likely to cause scars on the skin surface
  • downtime: Swelling and internal bleeding may continue for 1 to 2 weeks.
  • cost:Prices for both eyes vary depending on facility/plan.
  • Points to note: Excessive fat removal may lead to bags under the eyes.

It is especially effective if fat bulges are the main cause of dark circles, and removing the bulges will lighten the shadows under the eyes.

If too much fat is removed, the area under the eyes may become sunken, so be sure to check the extent of the procedure required and the experience of your surgeon.

There are clinics in Nagoya that offer transconjunctival degreasing, and the prices vary depending on the procedure and clinic, so be sure to check the total cost for both eyes.

After checking the amount of fat and the depth of the dent during your consultation, we will ask you to decide whether the treatment is appropriate.

The Urahamra method is a surgery that repositions the fat under the eyes to correct the bulges and hollows.

Rather than removing fat, the fat in the bulging area is moved and repositioned to the depression under the eyes (Golgo line/sulcus under the tear sac).

With this method,Aiming to improve both bulges and dents at the same timeThis makes it easier to form a smooth line under the eyes.

Overview of Ura Hamra method
  • approach: Relocation of fat from the conjunctival side to the depression. Less likely to cause scars on the skin surface
  • adaptation: Case where fat bulges and dents are mixed
  • downtime: Approximately 1 to 2 weeks (swelling may last for a long time)
  • cost:Prices for both eyes vary depending on facility/plan.

It is suitable for ``conditions in which fat bulges and depressions coexist'' that are difficult to resolve with transconjunctival degreasing alone, and is suitable for those with somewhat complex symptoms among black bears.

Downtime is about the same as transconjunctival degreasing.1-2 weeksThis is the standard, but because it involves moving fat, swelling may last longer.

Fat can be repositioned without making an incision on the skin surface of the lower eyelid, but if there is a lot of excess skin, a different surgical technique may be required.

The cost of the Urahamra method varies depending on the clinic, and the indications and scope of surgery are also different from transconjunctival degreasing, so be sure to check not only the price but also the treatment details.

Hamra method is a surgical procedure that involves skin incision and can treat severe sagging skin.

The Hamra method is a surgery in which an incision is made under the eyelashes of the lower eyelid and the orbital fat is moved to the hollow area under the eye.

Since the skin surface is cut, the Urahamra method cannot be used.Remove sagging skin and excess skin at the same time.Masu.

This treatment is suitable for people whose skin has become stretched and sagging due to aging, or for those who have been judged to be ineligible for the Ura Hamra method.

Overview of Hamra method
  • approach: An incision is made under the eyelashes and the fat is relocated. Excess skin can also be removed at the same time.
  • adaptation: People with strong skin sagging due to aging / Cases in which the Ura Hamra method is not applicable
  • downtime:About 2 to 4 weeks
  • cost:Depending on each facility, anesthesia and postoperative treatment fees may be charged separately.

There is no downtime as it involves surgical incisions.Approximately 2 to 4 weeksIt will be longer.

Please consider your work and life schedule when deciding how long it will take for the swelling, internal bleeding, and redness of the scar to subside.

There are complications with the Hamra method, such as a change in the position of the lower eyelid, so it is important to have your doctor explain the surgical experience and risks.

The cost of the Hamra method varies depending on the procedure and clinic, and anesthesia and post-operative treatment fees may be required separately.

When getting a quote,What is included in the total amount?It is important to have this clarified.

Hyaluronic acid injection is an injection treatment to correct sunken areas under the eyes.

Hyaluronic acid injection is a procedure that corrects puffiness by injecting hyaluronic acid into the hollow area under the eyes.

There is no need for surgery as it can be completed with just an injection, and the treatment time is only for both eyes.About 15-30 minutesThere are many clinics where you can apply makeup on the same day.

This is an effective option if you have blue or mild dark circles and the main problem is shadows caused by dents.

Overview of hyaluronic acid injection
  • Treatment time: Approximately 15 to 30 minutes for both eyes. There are many clinics that allow same-day makeup.
  • Lasting effect: About 6 months to 1 and a half years. If the effect wears off, maintain it with additional injections
  • Price guide: Around 50,000 to 100,000 yen per cc (Nagoya area)
  • Points to note: Risk of vascular occlusion. Choose a clinic that uses cannulas and has hyaluronidase on hand.

The duration of hyaluronic acid varies depending on the formulation and injection site, and as it is gradually absorbed by the body, re-examination may be considered depending on changes in effectiveness.

Hyaluronic acid injection into the eye area carries serious risks such as blood vessel occlusion, so please check with your doctor about what to do in case of an emergency.

The cost of injections varies depending on the type of preparation and amount required, so be sure to check not only the treatment fee but also the cost of re-examinations and additional injections.

Please confirm the required amount and total cost during your consultation and then decide whether or not to undergo the treatment.
